{{Quote|Then there's Gwen and Dani. Gwen's kind of the watcher in Gadrin, on Cularin, and Dani's the watcher in Hedrett.|[[Lora Nadad]]|<ref name="The Lost">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030213lost|text=The Lost}}</ref>}}
'''Gwen''' was an individual who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Gwen was on of a number of "[[Watcher (The Lost)|watchers]]," individuals who took care of the [[The Lost (children)|abandoned children]] of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and Gwen watched over children living in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]].<ref name="The Lost" />
